subject: CryptoPkg: add/modify EC interfaces for TPM TCG library
reasons: Primarily additive: 891 insertions adding new EC API functions (EcGroupInitGFp, EcGroupSetGenerator, EcPointsMul) across CryptoPkg driver, protocol, and library implementations
New API additions require consistent stub/null implementations across multiple files, but this is collateral addition not transformation
The CALL_BASECRYPTLIB pattern is repeated structurally, but the changes are adding new function wrappers, not transforming existing call sites
This is preparation for TCG TPM library integration - domain-specific API extension not a systematic rename/migration of existing patterns
